# Toast

A short confirmation after an action: "Copied", "Saved", "Subscription cancelled".

## Behaviour
- Bottom-left, 16 from the edges, stacking upward 8 apart. `role="status"`.
- Enters from below: translateY(100%) and opacity over 280ms (`dur-overlay`, `ease-out`); exits in 200ms. Transitions, not keyframes, so rapid toasts retarget smoothly.
- Auto-dismiss after 5s, paused on hover, focus, and while the tab is hidden. A toast with an action stays until acted on or dismissed.
- For reversible destructive actions, offer Undo here instead of a confirm dialog.
